Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
11:11 AM

The National Museum in New Delhi is open today, Sat 24 Oct, from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

Timings: Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
Closed: Mondays and national holidays. The next Monday is Mon 26 Oct.
Tickets: Adults ₹20. Foreign nationals ₹500. Students up to class 12 get free entry with their ID card.
Online booking: https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum
Address: Janpath, New Delhi 110011.

This comes from the museum's official Plan Your Visit page. I haven't booked anything.

These times come from a timetable site, not live booking. IRCTC blocked access, so seat availability and fares are not checked. The page was cut off after 11:25 AM, which doesn't affect the morning list.
